## Tools we reference

- [Claude Code](https://www.claude.com/product/claude-code) and [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex) — the agentic coding tools used in class.
- [chatlas](https://posit-dev.github.io/chatlas/) — calling LLMs from Python, including its [MCP tools guide](https://posit-dev.github.io/chatlas/misc/mcp-tools.html).
- [holtzy/dataviz-skills](https://github.com/holtzy/dataviz-skills) — data visualization skills, including `roast-my-chart`.
- [Great Tables skill](https://posit-dev.github.io/great-tables/skills.html) and the plotnine skill (`uvx library-skills install --claude -s plotnine`).
- [Transformer Explainer](https://poloclub.github.io/transformer-explainer/) and the [tokenizer playground](https://tiktokenizer.vercel.app/) — LLM demos in the browser.
- [markitdown](https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown) — convert documents to Markdown for an agent.
- **superpowers** — a spec-driven agentic skills framework (Skills meeting).
- **Roborev** — continuous AI code review that flags issues per commit (Verification meeting).
- **Middleman** — a local dashboard to triage, review, and merge issues & PRs.
- **Agentsview** — an agent session viewer for reviewing what your agents did.
